en.title: About the branch
en.excerpt: The Prosperity Party's office for the Harari Region: what it does, how it is organised and how to follow it.

content.text: The Prosperity Party Harari Region Branch Office (in Amharic የብልፅግና ፓርቲ የሀረሪ ክልል ቅርንጫፍ ጽሕፈት ቤት, in Afaan Oromo Waajjira Paartii Badhaadhinaa Damee Naannoo Hararii) leads the party's work in the Harari Region. It is headed by H.E Getu Weyessa Tola.
Organises the party's members and structures, from the branch office down to the woredas and basic organisations.
Leads the women's and youth wings and the branch's sectors: political and capacity building, organisation, public relations and media, democratic culture building, and strategic leadership and ICT.
Reviews the work of the party and of the regional government every quarter, together with the region's leaders.
Publishes its news on its public Telegram channel, in Amharic and the other languages of the region.

In the 7th general election of 2026 the Prosperity Party won 32 of the 36 seats of the Harari Regional Council and both of the region's seats in the House of Peoples' Representatives. The new council formed the regional government on 2 October 2026.
News from the branch appears on this site and on its Telegram channel,

am.title: ስለ ቅርንጫፉ
am.excerpt: የብልፅግና ፓርቲ የሀረሪ ክልል ቅርንጫፍ ጽሕፈት ቤት ተግባራት፣ አደረጃጀትና መረጃዎቹን የሚከታተሉበት መንገድ።

content.text: የብልፅግና ፓርቲ የሀረሪ ክልል ቅርንጫፍ ጽሕፈት ቤት በሀረሪ ክልል የፓርቲውን ሥራዎች ይመራል። ጽሕፈት ቤቱን የሚመሩት ክቡር አቶ ጌቱ ወዬሳ ቶላ ናቸው።
የፓርቲውን አባላትና አደረጃጀቶች ከቅርንጫፍ ጽሕፈት ቤቱ እስከ ወረዳዎችና መሰረታዊ ድርጅቶች ያደራጃል።
የሴቶችና የወጣቶች ክንፎችን እንዲሁም የፖለቲካና አቅም ግንባታ፣ የአደረጃጀት፣ የሕዝብ ግንኙነትና ሚዲያ፣ የዴሞክራሲ ባህል ግንባታ እና የስትራቴጂ አመራርና የኢንፎርሜሽን ኮሙኒኬሽን ቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፎችን ይመራል።
ከክልሉ አመራሮች ጋር በመሆን የፓርቲውንና የክልሉን መንግሥት ሥራዎች በየሩብ ዓመቱ ይገመግማል።
ዜናዎቹን በይፋዊ የቴሌግራም ቻናሉ በአማርኛና በሌሎች የክልሉ ቋንቋዎች ያሰራጫል።
ብልፅግና ፓርቲ በ2018 ዓ.ም. በተካሄደው 7ኛው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ከሀረሪ ክልል ምክር ቤት 36 መቀመጫዎች 32ቱን፣ እንዲሁም ክልሉ በሕዝብ ተወካዮች ምክር ቤት ያሉትን ሁለቱንም መቀመጫዎች አሸንፏል። አዲሱ ምክር ቤት መስከረም 22 ቀን 2019 ዓ.ም. የክልሉን መንግሥት መሥርቷል።
የቅርንጫፉ ዜናዎች በዚህ ድረ ገጽና በቴሌግራም ቻናሉ

om.title: Waa'ee damee
om.excerpt: Hojii, caasaa fi odeeffannoo Waajjira Paartii Badhaadhinaa Damee Naannoo Hararii.

content.text: Waajjirri Paartii Badhaadhinaa Damee Naannoo Hararii hojii paartii Naannoo Hararii keessatti ni geggeessa. Waajjirri kun Kabajamoo Obbo Geetuu Wayyeessaa Tolaatiin durfama.
Miseensotaa fi caasaalee paartii waajjira damee irraa hanga aanaalee fi jaarmiyaalee bu'uuraatti ni ijaara.

Kutaalee dubartootaa fi dargaggootaa, akkasumas kutaalee hojii siyaasaa fi ijaarsa dandeettii, ijaarsa jaarmiyaa, quunnamtii hawaasaa fi miidiyaa, ijaarsa aadaa dimokraasii, fi hoggansa tarsiimoo fi teeknoolojii odeeffannoo ni geggeessa.
Hoggantoota naannichaa waliin hojii paartii fi mootummaa naannoo kurmaana kurmaanaan ni gamaaggama.
Oduu isaa chaanaalii Teleegiraamii isaa irratti Afaan Amaaraa fi afaanota naannichaa biroon ni tamsaasa.

Paartiin Badhaadhinaa filannoo waliigalaa 7ffaa bara 2026 irratti teessoo Mana Marii Naannoo Hararii 36 keessaa 32, akkasumas teessoo naannichi Mana Bakka Bu'oota Ummataa keessatti qabu lamaanuu mo'ateera. Manni marii haaraan Onkololeessa 2, 2026 mootummaa naannichaa hundeesseera.
Oduun damichaa marsariitii kana fi chaanaalii Teleegiraamii isaa

en.title: History
en.excerpt: From the Harari National League to the Prosperity Party, and the general elections of 2021 and 2026.

content.text: The Harari National League (HNL) was founded in 1991. Until 2019 it led the Harari Region as a party allied to the EPRDF.

At its 11th organisational conference on 17 November 2019, the HNL announced that it would merge into the Prosperity Party. The parties of the EPRDF merged on 18 November, and the Prosperity Party was formally established on 21 November 2019.

6th general election: Harari voted on 30 September 2021. The Prosperity Party won both of the region's seats in the House of Peoples' Representatives and all three constituencies of the regional council. On 22 October 2021 the new council re-elected Ordin Bedri as president of the region.

7th general election: the vote was held on 1 June 2026 and the National Election Board of Ethiopia announced the final results on 21 June. Of the 36 seats of the regional council, the Prosperity Party won 32; the Ethiopian National Unity Party, the Freedom and Equality Party and the Harari Democratic Organisation won one each, and one seat went to an independent candidate.

The 7th-term regional council held its first session on 2 October 2026. It re-elected Sultan Abduselam as speaker and Arif Mohamed as deputy speaker, re-appointed Ordin Bedri as president, and approved the cabinet, with Roza Umar as deputy president and Mukhtar Saleh as head of the Urban Development and Construction Bureau with the rank of deputy president. The Harari National Assembly elected Muhyedin Ahmed as its speaker and Amina Abdukerim as deputy speaker.

am.title: ታሪክ
am.excerpt: ከሀረሪ ብሔራዊ ሊግ እስከ ብልፅግና ፓርቲ፤ 6ኛውና 7ኛው አጠቃላይ ምርጫዎች።

content.text: ሀረሪ ብሔራዊ ሊግ እ.ኤ.አ. በ1991 ተመሠረተ። እስከ 2019 ድረስ ከኢሕአዴግ ጋር አጋር ፓርቲ ሆኖ የሀረሪ ክልልን መርቷል።
ሀረሪ ብሔራዊ ሊግ ኅዳር 7 ቀን 2012 ዓ.ም. ባካሄደው 11ኛው ድርጅታዊ ጉባኤ ወደ ብልፅግና ፓርቲ እንደሚዋሐድ አሳወቀ። የኢሕአዴግ አባል ፓርቲዎች ኅዳር 8 ቀን ተዋሐዱ፤ ብልፅግና ፓርቲ ኅዳር 11 ቀን 2012 ዓ.ም. በይፋ ተመሠረተ።

6ኛው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ፦ ሀረሪ መስከረም 20 ቀን 2014 ዓ.ም. ድምፅ ሰጠ። ብልፅግና ፓርቲ ክልሉ በሕዝብ ተወካዮች ምክር ቤት ያሉትን ሁለቱንም መቀመጫዎችና የክልሉን ምክር ቤት ሦስቱንም የምርጫ ክልሎች አሸነፈ። አዲሱ ምክር ቤት ጥቅምት 12 ቀን 2014 ዓ.ም. አቶ ኦርዲን በድሪን በድጋሚ የክልሉ ርዕሰ መስተዳድር አድርጎ መረጠ።

7ኛው አጠቃላይ ምርጫ፦ ድምፅ የተሰጠው ግንቦት 24 ቀን 2018 ዓ.ም. ሲሆን የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ምርጫ ቦርድ የመጨረሻ ውጤቱን ሰኔ 14 ቀን 2018 ዓ.ም. አሳወቀ። 36 መቀመጫ ካለው የክልሉ ምክር ቤት ብልፅግና ፓርቲ 32ቱን አሸነፈ፤ የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ አንድነት ፓርቲ፣ ነፃነትና እኩልነት ፓርቲ እና የሐረሪ ዴሞክራሲያዊ ድርጅት እያንዳንዳቸው አንድ መቀመጫ አገኙ፤ አንዱን መቀመጫ የግል ዕጩ አሸነፈ።

7ኛው ዙር የክልሉ ምክር ቤት መስከረም 22 ቀን 2019 ዓ.ም. የመጀመሪያ ጉባኤውን አካሄደ። አቶ ሱልጣን አብዱሰላምን ዋና አፈ ጉባኤ፣ አቶ አሪፍ መሀመድን ምክትል አፈ ጉባኤ አድርጎ በድጋሚ መረጠ፤ አቶ ኦርዲን በድሪን በድጋሚ ርዕሰ መስተዳድር አድርጎ ሾመ፤ ወ/ሮ ሮዛ ኡመርን ምክትል ርዕሰ መስተዳድር፣ አቶ ሙክታር ሳሊህን በምክትል ርዕሰ መስተዳድር ማዕረግ የከተማ ልማትና ኮንስትራክሽን ቢሮ ኃላፊ አድርጎ ጨምሮ የካቢኔ አባላትን አጸደቀ። የሀረሪ ብሔራዊ ጉባኤ አቶ ሙህየዲን አህመድን ዋና አፈ ጉባኤ፣ ወይዘሮ አሚና አብዱከሪምን ምክትል አፈ ጉባኤ አድርጎ መረጠ።
Prosperity Party: formation of the party

om.title: Seenaa
om.excerpt: Liigii Biyyoolessaa Hararii irraa hanga Paartii Badhaadhinaatti, fi filannoowwan waliigalaa 2021 fi 2026.

content.text: Liigiin Biyyoolessaa Hararii (HNL) bara 1991 hundeeffame. Hanga bara 2019tti paartii ADWUI waliin hiriyyaa ta'ee Naannoo Hararii geggeessaa ture.

HNL walgahii jaarmiyaa 11ffaa Sadaasa 17, 2019 geggeesse irratti Paartii Badhaadhinaatti makamuuf murteessuu isaa beeksise. Paartileen ADWUI Sadaasa 18 walitti makaman; Paartiin Badhaadhinaa Sadaasa 21, 2019 seeraan hundeeffame.

Filannoo waliigalaa 6ffaa: Hararii keessatti sagaleen Fulbaana 30, 2021 kenname. Paartiin Badhaadhinaa teessoo naannichi Mana Bakka Bu'oota Ummataa keessatti qabu lamaanuu fi naannolee filannoo mana marii naannoo sadanuu mo'ate. Onkololeessa 22, 2021 manni marii haaraan Obbo Ordiin Badrii irra deebiin pireezidaantii naannichaa godhee filate.

Filannoo waliigalaa 7ffaa: sagaleen Waxabajjii 1, 2026 kenname; Boordiin Filannoo Biyyoolessaa Itoophiyaa bu'aa xumuraa Waxabajjii 21 beeksise. Teessoo mana marii naannoo 36 keessaa Paartiin Badhaadhinaa 32 mo'ate; Paartiin Tokkummaa Biyyoolessaa Itoophiyaa, Paartiin Bilisummaa fi Walqixxummaa, fi Dhaabbanni Dimokraatawaa Hararii tokko tokko argatan; teessoo tokko immoo dorgomaa dhuunfaa tokkotu mo'ate.

Manni marii naannoo bara 7ffaa Onkololeessa 2, 2026 walgahii isaa jalqabaa geggeesse. Sultan Abduselam afyaa'ii, Arif Mohamed itti aanaa afyaa'ii godhee irra deebiin filate; Obbo Ordiin Badrii irra deebiin pireezidaantii godhee muude; kaabinee, Aadde Roozaa Umar itti aantuu pireezidaantii fi Mukhtar Saleh sadarkaa itti aanaa pireezidaantiitiin itti gaafatamaa Biiroo Misooma Magaalaa fi Ijaarsaa godhee, raggaasise. Yaa'iin Biyyoolessaa Hararii Muhyedin Ahmed afyaa'ii, Amina Abdukerim itti aantuu afyaa'ii godhee filate.

en.title: Harar and the Harari Region
en.excerpt: The walled city of Harar Jugol, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and the region the branch serves.

content.text: The historic town of Harar Jugol has been on UNESCO's World Heritage List since 2006. Its wall, the Jugol, was built between the 13th and 16th centuries. Within its 48 hectares stand 82 mosques, three of them from the 10th century, and 102 shrines. UNESCO notes that Harar is considered the fourth holy city of Islam.
The wall has five historic gates, which matched the main roads and the five quarters of the old town, and a sixth added later, the Harar Gate.

Traditional Harari townhouses and the Indian-style houses with wooden verandas, built by Indian merchants at the end of the 19th century, give the town its character. The patterns on this site come from the woven basket plates that hang on the walls of Harari homes.
Harar was the capital of the Harari Kingdom from 1520 to 1568 and an independent emirate in the 17th century, and has been part of Ethiopia since 1887.
Nine woredas: six in the city of Harar (Amir-Nur, Abadir, Jinela, Hakim, Shenkor and Aboker) and three rural woredas (Sofi, Erer and Dire Teyara).
Population: 183,415 at the 2007 census; the Ethiopian Statistics Service projected about 276,000 for 2022.
Mother tongues at the 2007 census: Afaan Oromo 56.8%, Amharic 27.5%, Harari 7.3%, Somali 3.7% and Gurage 2.9%.
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Harar Jugol

am.title: ሀረርና የሀረሪ ክልል
am.excerpt: በዩኔስኮ የዓለም ቅርስነት የተመዘገበችው ቅጥር ከተማ ሀረር ጀጎል እና ቅርንጫፉ የሚያገለግለው ክልል።

content.text: ታሪካዊቷ የሀረር ጀጎል ከተማ ከ1998 ዓ.ም. ጀምሮ በዩኔስኮ የዓለም ቅርሶች መዝገብ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። ጀጎል የተባለው ቅጥሯ ከ13ኛው እስከ 16ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ባለው ጊዜ ተገንብቷል። በ48 ሄክታር ቅጥር ውስጥ 82 መስጊዶች፣ ከእነዚህም ሦስቱ የ10ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን፣ እና 102 ቅዱሳን ስፍራዎች ይገኛሉ። ዩኔስኮ እንደሚገልጸው ሀረር አራተኛዋ የእስልምና ቅድስት ከተማ ተደርጋ ትታያለች።
ቅጥሩ ከዋና ዋና መንገዶችና ከጥንቷ ከተማ አምስት ሰፈሮች ጋር የሚገናኙ አምስት ታሪካዊ በሮች እና በኋላ የተጨመረ ስድስተኛ በር፣ የሀረር በር፣ አለው።
ባህላዊ የሀረሪ ቤቶች እና በ19ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን መጨረሻ የህንድ ነጋዴዎች የገነቧቸው የእንጨት በረንዳ ያላቸው ቤቶች ለከተማዋ ልዩ ገጽታ ይሰጣሉ። በዚህ ድረ ገጽ ላይ የሚታዩት ቅጦች በሀረሪ ቤቶች ግድግዳ ላይ ከሚሰቀሉት የሰፌድ ሥራዎች የተወሰዱ ናቸው።
ሀረር እ.ኤ.አ. ከ1520 እስከ 1568 የሀረሪ መንግሥት ዋና ከተማ፣ በ17ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ራሷን የቻለች ኢሚሬት ነበረች፤ ከ1887 ጀምሮ የኢትዮጵያ አካል ሆናለች።
ዘጠኝ ወረዳዎች፦ በሀረር ከተማ ውስጥ ስድስት (አሚር ኑር፣ አባድር፣ ጅኔላ፣ ሀኪም፣ ሸንኮር እና አቦከር) እና ሦስት የገጠር ወረዳዎች (ሶፊ፣ ኤረር እና ድሬ ጠያራ)።
የሕዝብ ብዛት፦ በ1999 ዓ.ም. የሕዝብና ቤት ቆጠራ 183,415፤ የኢትዮጵያ ስታቲስቲክስ አገልግሎት እ.ኤ.አ. ለ2022 ወደ 276,000 ገደማ ገምቷል።
በ1999 ዓ.ም. ቆጠራ የአፍ መፍቻ ቋንቋዎች፦ አፋን ኦሮሞ 56.8%፣ አማርኛ 27.5%፣ ሀረሪ 7.3%፣ ሶማሊኛ 3.7% እና ጉራጊኛ 2.9%።
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Harar Jugol

om.title: Harar fi Naannoo Hararii
om.excerpt: Magaalaa dallaa qabdu Harar Jugol, hambaa addunyaa UNESCO, fi naannoo damichi tajaajilu.

content.text: Magaalaan seenaa qabeettiin Harar Jugol bara 2006 irraa kaasee galmee hambaa addunyaa UNESCO keessa jirti. Dallaan ishee, Jugol, jaarraa 13ffaa fi 16ffaa gidduutti ijaarame. Lafa hektaara 48 keessatti masjiidota 82, kanneen keessaa sadii jaarraa 10ffaa, fi iddoowwan qulqulluu 102 ni argamu. Akka UNESCO ibsutti, Harar magaalaa qulqulluu Islaamaa afraffaa jedhamtee ilaalamti.
Dallaan kun karrawwan seenaa shan, kanneen karaalee gurguddoo fi ollaawwan magaalattii durii shanan waliin walsiman, fi karra jahaffaa booda dabalame, Karra Harar, qaba.

Manneen aadaa Hararii fi manneen balbala mukaa qaban kanneen daldaltoonni Hindii xumura jaarraa 19ffaatti ijaaran magaalattiif bifa addaa kennu. Faayiin marsariitii kana irratti mul'atu gabatee hodhaa dallaa manneen Hararii irratti fannifamu irraa fudhatame.
Harar bara 1520 hanga 1568tti magaalaa guddoo Mootummaa Hararii, jaarraa 17ffaatti immoo imireetii of danda'e turte; bara 1887 irraa kaasee kutaa Itoophiyaa taate.
Aanaalee sagal: jaha magaalaa Harar keessatti (Amir-Nur, Abadir, Jinela, Hakim, Shenkor fi Aboker) fi sadii baadiyyaatti (Soofii, Erer fi Dirree Xiyyaaraa).
Baay'ina ummataa: lakkoofsa ummataa bara 2007tti 183,415; Tajaajilli Istaatistiksii Itoophiyaa bara 2022f gara 276,000 tilmaameera.
Afaan dhalootaa lakkoofsa bara 2007tti: Afaan Oromoo 56.8%, Afaan Amaaraa 27.5%, Afaan Hararii 7.3%, Afaan Somaalii 3.7% fi Afaan Guraagee 2.9%.
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Harar Jugol

content.text: The Women's Wing organises the party's women members in the Harari Region, from its regional office to the woredas and institutions. It is led by Zinet Yusuf, with Tuna Ibrahim as deputy head.
September 2026: members of the women's and youth wings gave blood on Resurgence Day.

July 2026: the wing reviewed its work for the 2018 E.C. budget year and set a 90-day plan. The review covered women's share in decision-making bodies at every level, their part in development, corridor development and Green Legacy programmes, and job creation and economic self-reliance.
December 2025: training for the wing on using social media, given by the branch's public relations sector.
October 2025: school supplies for students at the Harar correctional centre, under the theme “While I am here, no student will drop out for lack of school materials”.
የሴቶች ክንፍ በሀረሪ ክልል የሚገኙ የፓርቲውን ሴት አባላት ከክልል ጽሕፈት ቤቱ እስከ ወረዳዎችና ተቋማት ያደራጃል። ክንፉን የሚመሩት ወይዘሮ ዚነት ዩሱፍ ሲሆኑ ምክትል ኃላፊዋ ወ/ሪት ቱና ኢብራሂም ናቸው።
ጳጉሜን 2018 ዓ.ም.፦ የሴቶችና የወጣቶች ክንፍ አባላት በማንሰራራት ቀን ደም ለግሰዋል።

ሐምሌ 2018 ዓ.ም.፦ ክንፉ የ2018 በጀት ዓመት የዕቅድ አፈፃፀሙን ገምግሞ የ90 ቀናት ዕቅድ አስተዋውቋል። ግምገማው ሴቶች በየደረጃው ባሉ የውሳኔ ሰጪ አካላት ያላቸውን ድርሻ፣ በልማት፣ በኮሪደር ልማትና በአረንጓዴ አሻራ መርሐ ግብሮች ያላቸውን ተሳትፎ እንዲሁም የሥራ ዕድል ፈጠራንና በኢኮኖሚ ራስን መቻልን ዳስሷል።
ኅዳር 2018 ዓ.ም.፦ በቅርንጫፉ የሕዝብ ግንኙነት ዘርፍ ለክንፉ አደረጃጀት በማኅበራዊ ሚዲያ አጠቃቀም ዙሪያ ስልጠና ተሰጥቷል።
ጥቅምት 2018 ዓ.ም.፦ «እኔ እያለሁ አንድም ተማሪ በትምህርት ቁሳቁስ ችግር ከትምህርት ገበታ አይገለልም» በሚል መሪ ሀሳብ በሀረር ማረሚያ ቤት ለሚገኙ ተማሪዎች የትምህርት ቁሳቁስ ድጋፍ ተደርጓል።

Kutaan Dubartootaa miseensota dubartootaa paartii Naannoo Hararii waajjira naannoo irraa hanga aanaalee fi dhaabbileetti ni ijaara. Kutaan kun Aadde Zinet Yusufiin kan durfamu yoo ta'u, itti aantuun ishee Durba Tuna Ibrahim dha.
Fulbaana 2026: miseensonni kutaa dubartootaa fi dargaggootaa dhiiga arjoomaniiru.

Adoolessa 2026: kutaan raawwii karoora bara baajataa 2018 gamaaggamee karoora guyyaa 90 baaseera. Gamaaggamni kun qooda dubartootaa qaamolee murtee sadarkaa hundaa irratti, hirmaannaa isaanii misooma, misooma koriidaraa fi sagantaa Ashaaraa Magariisaa keessatti, akkasumas uumama carraa hojii fi of danda'uu dinagdee ilaaleera.
Muddee 2025: kutaa hojii quunnamtii hawaasaa dameetiin kutaa kanaaf leenjiin itti fayyadama miidiyaa hawaasaa kennameera.
Onkololeessa 2025: mana sirreessaa Harar keessatti barattootaaf meeshaalee barnootaa gumaachameera.
The Youth Wing organises the party's young members in the Harari Region and runs volunteer and support programmes.

September 2026: with the Yenege Tiwlid Tesfa youth association, school supplies for more than 523 students in Sukul kebele, Dire Teyara woreda. The wing has supported schools in this way for several years.
September 2026: members of the youth and women's wings gave blood on Resurgence Day.
የወጣቶች ክንፍ በሀረሪ ክልል የሚገኙ የፓርቲውን ወጣት አባላት ያደራጃል፤ የበጎ ፈቃድና የድጋፍ መርሐ ግብሮችንም ያካሂዳል።
መስከረም 2019 ዓ.ም.፦ ከየነገ ትውልድ ተስፋ ወጣቶች ማኅበር ጋር በመተባበር በድሬ ጠያራ ወረዳ ሱቁል ቀበሌ ከ523 በላይ ለሚሆኑ ተማሪዎች የትምህርት ቁሳቁስ ድጋፍ ተደርጓል፤ ክንፉ ለትምህርት ቤቶች ድጋፍ ማድረግ ለዓመታት ሲያከናውን ቆይቷል።
ጳጉሜን 2018 ዓ.ም.፦ የወጣቶችና የሴቶች ክንፍ አባላት በማንሰራራት ቀን ደም ለግሰዋል።
Kutaan Dargaggootaa miseensota dargaggootaa paartii Naannoo Hararii ni ijaara; sagantaalee tola ooltummaa fi deeggarsaas ni geggeessa.

Fulbaana 2026: waldaa dargaggootaa 'Yenege Tiwlid Tesfa' waliin, aanaa Dirree Xiyyaaraa ganda Sukul keessatti barattoota 523 ol ta'aniif meeshaaleen barnootaa gumaachameera. Kutaan kun waggoota hedduuf haala kanaan mana barumsaa deeggaraa tureera.
Fulbaana 2026: miseensonni kutaa dargaggootaa fi dubartootaa dhiiga arjoomaniiru.
